title: One pipeline, three stages
prompt: Using ONE stream pipeline per method (no loops): `loudLongNames` returns the names longer than 3 characters, uppercased, sorted alphabetically. `sumLengths` returns the total character count of all words (empty list -> 0).

tests.name: filter, map, sort, collect
tests.hint: names.stream().filter(...).map(String::toUpperCase).sorted().collect(...) - do not drop the sorted() stage.

tests.name: primitive stream sums
tests.hint: mapToInt(String::length).sum() handles the empty case for free.
